protocol.noise_fraction_convention: Hard PEAK caps + ADC half step; coherent controls violate ADC-only caps.

limits: Uniform synthetic supports and correct-frequency sinusoidal model only; no field, frequency-uncertainty, gain/polarity, CT, anti-alias, clock or location certification. Physical bias is measured on ideal signals; additive coverage excludes cap-violating controls.
